newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Hua Fei completes US $200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Hua Fei completes US $200 mln loan.

text.p: Hua Fei Colour Display Systems Co's U.S. $200 million export credit agency backed term loan facility has closed with a substantial oversubscription but will not be increased, said the arrangers.

The borrower is a sino-foreign equity joint venture established in Nanjing and engaged in the production of colour TV and monitor tubes. Shareholders are Philips Electronics China BV with 55 percent, China National Huadong Electron Tube Factory with 25 percent and Jiangsu Province Investment Co with 20 percent.
The facility has a maturity of five years with an average life of 3.75 years. It pay a margin of 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 40 basis points for senior lead managers, 30 basis points for lead managers and 25 basis points for co-lead managers. There is a commitment fee of 25 basis points.
ABN AMRO Bank and CCIC Finance are arrangers.
Lenders providing funds to the borrower in this transaction are as follows: ABN AMRO Bank is the arranger.
Bank of America NT & SA and Standard Chartered Bank are co-arrangers.

Senior lead managers are First National Bank of Chicago, Industrial Bank of Japan, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, Commerzbank Shanghai branch, Credit Lyonnais, Credit Suisse Shanghai branch, DKB Shanghai branch, DBS Bank Shanghai branch, Dresdner Bank Shanghai branch, Fuji Bank, ING Bank Shanghai branch, Kredietbank Project Finance, Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan, De Nationale Investeringsbank Asia, NatWest Markets, Rabobank Hong Kong branch, Sakura Bank, Societe Generale Shanghai branch, Sumitomo Bank Singapore branch and Tokai Bank Hong Kong branch.
Co-lead managers are Banca di Roma Shanghai branch and Credit Commercial de France Hong Kong branch.
